chunks: Abān narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, that he said:

Regarding an animal that is slaughtered while there is a fetus in its womb, he said: “If it is fully formed, then eat it, for its slaughter is the slaughter of its mother. But if it is not fully formed, then do not eat it.”

key_terms.ذَكَاةُ أُمِّهِ: the slaughter of its mother, which suffices for it

ai.seo_question: Is a fetus found inside a slaughtered animal halal to eat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about a fetus found inside a slaughtered animal. If the fetus is fully formed, it is lawful to eat because its valid slaughter follows from the slaughter of its mother; if it is not fully formed, it is not to be eaten.
